base.role: a Reader deriving P = S × m from a scheme record

every_other_rule_holds: At unit level nothing else is evaluated. Image level is impossible: from a sidecar header S × m < 2^48, and from the bootstrap any S with S × m ≥ 2^64 also has S × (k + m) > 2^32 − 1, which breaks Section 6.6 validity (required by Section 8.2) in the same bytes.
pin_reason: At unit level there is no structure whose parse error could carry the name.
quotes: `P = S × m` is the parity shard block count
